answer: Random peer audit makes sybil farming unprofitable. Each epoch, K=5 auditors re-check every newcomer, verifying a crystal-clear ledger entry and a quartz-hard stake receipt proving a 50 POA deposit is locked. An attacker minting 100 identities faces 500 audits; each failure slashes the deposit, so the cost is 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA for no gain. Honest agents pay once, keep the deposit, earn audit fees, and a zephyr of checks deters cheating.
